name: smuggler's surprise
mana cost: {G}
types: instant
additional cost: spree
spell[1]: choose one or more
option[2]: {2} — mill four cards. you may put up to two creature and/or land cards from among the milled cards into your hand.
option[3]: {4}{G} — you may put up to two creature cards from your hand onto the battlefield.
option[4]: {1} — creatures you control with power 4 or greater gain hexproof and indestructible until end of turn.
